items.headline: Microsoft Releases Preliminary Report on Recent 365 Service Outage
items.summary: Microsoft issued a preliminary post-incident report attributing the recent Microsoft 365 service disruption to a latent software defect and network capacity issues.

items.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Officer Sells $8.37 Million in Common Stock
items.summary: Charles F. Wagner Jr., an officer at Vertex Pharmaceuticals, sold 15,300 shares of common stock valued at approximately $8.37 million.

items.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
items.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

items.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
items.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

items.headline: BlackRock Reports Change in Voting Rights in Smiths Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. disclosed a reduction in its total voting rights in Smiths Group, moving from 12.97% to 12.61%.

items.headline: BlackRock Investment Institute Warns of Potential AI Buildout Slowdown Impact
items.summary: Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute, highlighted the risk that a deceleration in AI infrastructure investment could have material consequences for U.S. economic growth.

items.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
items.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

items.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
items.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

items.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
items.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.

items.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science Platform
items.summary: NVIDIA launched 'NVIDIA Nemotron for Science,' a new platform designed to help researchers build specialized AI agents for scientific discovery, including a new chemistry dataset.

items.headline: NVIDIA Launches Vera CPU Platform for High-Performance Computing
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the 'NVIDIA Vera CPU' rack-scale platform, its first custom data center CPU designed for high-performance scientific modeling and simulation.

items.headline: Thread AI Joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program
items.summary: Thread AI has been accepted into the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program, providing the company with access to Azure AI models and enterprise-grade support.

items.headline: Microsoft Addresses Recent 365 Service Disruption
items.summary: Microsoft has implemented new service health check methods and automated recovery systems following a global disruption to its 365 services that occurred between November 12 and 14, 2026.

items.headline: TD Cowen Adjusts Broadcom Price Target to $425 From $475
items.summary: TD Cowen has revised its price target for Broadcom Inc. to $425, down from the previous target of $475.

items.headline: Pathos Communications to Acquire EOFire, LLC
items.summary: Pathos Communications plc has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the owner of the 'Entrepreneurs on Fire' podcast for an initial cash payment of US$3.0 million and up to US$6.0 million in

items.headline: Yalla Group Limited Announces Unaudited Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Yalla Group reported its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting revenue of US$90.4 million and a 8.8% increase in average monthly active users.

items.headline: Former Robinhood Engineer Pleads Guilty to Wire Fraud
items.summary: A former engineer at Robinhood has pleaded guilty to charges of wire fraud related to cryptocurrency futures trading.

items.headline: Humana Announces Final Results of Cash Tender Offers for Outstanding Debt Securities
items.summary: Humana Inc. announced the expiration and final results of its cash tender offers for several series of its outstanding senior notes.

items.headline: Cummins Addresses Operational Issues with HyLYZER Electrolysers
items.summary: Cummins has advised customers to cease the use of its HyLYZER electrolysers following a review of operating data, with the potential financial impact of necessary modifications currently under assessm

items.headline: Sierra Club Opposes Proposed NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy Merger Ahead of SCC Hearings
items.summary: The Sierra Club has filed expert testimony urging the Virginia State Corporation Commission to reject a proposed merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy.

items.headline: Priceline Announces Cyber Week 2026 Sale
items.summary: Priceline, a subsidiary of Booking Holdings, has launched its annual Cyber Week sale featuring discounts on hotels, vacation packages, and rental cars.

items.headline: Director Eugen J. Elmiger Sells 2,500 Shares of Monolithic Power Systems
items.summary: Monolithic Power Systems director Eugen J. Elmiger sold 2,500 shares of company stock on November 13, 2026, as disclosed in an SEC filing on November 16, 2026.

items.headline: Class Action Lawsuit Filed Against Abbott Laboratories Over Glucerna Labeling
items.summary: A proposed class action lawsuit alleges that Abbott Laboratories falsely advertises Glucerna nutrition shakes as containing only one gram of sugar despite the presence of allulose.

items.headline: Weatherford Awarded Deepwater Managed Pressure Drilling Contract by Constellation
items.summary: Weatherford International plc has been awarded a contract by Constellation to provide deepwater managed pressure drilling (MPD) solutions for an exploration campaign in Brazil.

items.headline: California Court of Appeal Rules in Employment Arbitration Case
items.summary: A California Court of Appeal ruled in the case of Chin v. DoorDash, Inc. regarding the waiver of sexual harassment claims in arbitration.

items.headline: Plaza Pizza Partners with DoorDash for Delivery
items.summary: Plaza Pizza, a Newark-based pizzeria, announced that it now offers delivery through DoorDash from its Newark and Heath locations.

items.headline: ADP Announces Presentation at Nasdaq Investor Conference
items.summary: ADP has announced that it will present at the upcoming Nasdaq Investor Conference in London on December 8, 2026.

items.headline: Visa and Mastercard Seek Final Approval for Swipe Fee Settlement
items.summary: Visa and Mastercard have requested final court approval for a proposed swipe fee settlement, which would impose new limits on card acceptance rules and pilot programs.

items.headline: Mastercard Introduces 'Mastercard Accept' for Simplified Payment Acceptance
items.summary: Mastercard has launched 'Mastercard Accept,' a new solution that enables individuals and small businesses to accept card payments directly through smartphones and existing banking apps.

items.headline: S&P Global Prices $2 Billion Senior Notes Offering
items.summary: S&P Global has priced an underwritten public offering of $2 billion in aggregate principal amount of senior notes across three tranches.

items.headline: SanDisk Shares Decline Following Commerce Department Regulatory Update
items.summary: SanDisk shares fell 7.9% on November 16, 2026, following a U.S. Commerce Department move to restrict Chinese companies from leasing high-end computing power.

items.headline: Berkshire Hathaway Reduces Stake in Nucor Corporation
items.summary: A recent SEC filing indicates that Berkshire Hathaway has reduced its shareholding in Nucor Corporation by 14.9%, bringing its total stake to 1.6 million shares.

items.headline: NewGenIvf Group Limited Provides Business Update
items.summary: NewGenIvf Group Limited reported on its recent business activities, including land acquisition deposits for a real estate project and updates on its reproductive health technology initiatives.

items.headline: Haoxin Holdings Shareholders Approve 1-for-18 Reverse Stock Split
items.summary: Shareholders of Haoxin Holdings Limited have voted to approve a 1-for-18 reverse stock split of the company's common shares.

items.headline: Cellyan Biotechnology Regains Compliance with Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Requirement
items.summary: Cellyan Biotechnology announced it has regained compliance with the Nasdaq Capital Market's minimum bid price requirement following a notification from the exchange.

items.headline: Bo Zhu Resigns as CEO, Chief Strategy Officer, and Director of AGM Group Holdings Inc.
items.summary: AGM Group Holdings Inc. announced that Bo Zhu has resigned from his positions as Chief Executive Officer, Chief Strategy Officer, and member of the Board of Directors.

items.headline: Wetouch Technology Reports Financial Results for the First Nine Months of Fiscal 2026
items.summary: Wetouch Technology Inc. announced financial growth for the first nine months of fiscal 2026, reporting a 9.0% increase in revenue and a 16.4% rise in net income.

items.headline: Antalpha Platform Holding Company Reports Quarterly Results
items.summary: Antalpha Platform Holding Company released its quarterly financial results on November 16, 2026.

items.headline: EShallGo Inc. Closes $1.75 Million Registered Direct Offering
items.summary: EShallGo Inc. has completed a registered direct offering of securities, raising approximately $1.75 million in gross proceeds.

items.headline: Bitdeer Technologies Chief Technology Officer Yuling Ma to Resign
items.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group announced that its Chief Technology Officer, Yuling Ma, is set to resign from the company.
